facts.fact: StackAdapt reported a 95% recommendation rate on G2 Crowd, per its own claim in the 2017 awards post.
facts.quote: We’re proud to say we’re the only platform with a 95% recommendation rate and a 100% agreement rate on the direction of the product.

facts.fact: StackAdapt ranked 6th in Canada on the Technology Fast 50 program, per the company's post.
facts.quote: our speedy growth ranked us 6th in Canada and 23rd in North America.

facts.fact: The STARTUP 50 ranks Canada's top new growth companies by two-year revenue growth.
facts.quote: The STARTUP 50 ranks Canada’s top new growth companies by two-year revenue growth, and profiles the fastest-growing startups in the country.

facts.fact: StackAdapt's COO said maintaining triple-digit year-over-year growth is harder than growing a startup, per the company's post.
facts.quote: Growing a startup is hard, maintaining a triple-digit year-over-year growth is even harder.
